source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: My name is Alex M.. I am a 3rd grade student in a veterinian faculty in Ankara. Normally, I live in Manisa but came to Ankara for studying. I came to Manisa as it is semester now. I am 22 years old. In my free time, I like playing games alone and with my friends. That’s all.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I cannot tell one is my favorite. Sometimes I enjoy multiplayer games. When I play alone, I enjoy football manager which is a simulation game. I was playing it before this interview. It’s like an addiction. It’s basic actually but I cannot control myself. Even the same game is launched in every month in every year, I cannot control myself and check it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: The games with my friends.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: In general, the games which can be called shooter games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Exactly. Also, as my friends like that genre. I joined them after a while.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: When we play multiplayer games, the fact that your opponent is a real person instead of a computer makes you more sad or happier when you win or be defeated. The exitement and happiness that it gives is better.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Yes, I played RPG. I played a lot some of them and I tried some recently and couldn’t spare much time. But there are some that are in my list and my library.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I hope I will find a free time to play.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: As I am playing with my friends. When I am playing with my friends, we prefer shooter and FPS games more. It’s better when we play together. When I play alone, I also play RPGs.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Counter Strike Global Offensive. Battlefield I. Hunt. It’s been a while I haven’t played Hunt but I like it a lot. We also play other Battlefield games. I don’t remember others. Let me check my library.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: In general, I play those recently.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I haven’t thought about it before but theme is important. For instance, the reason that I like Battlefield and Hunt is that I like its theme. One is during World War II and the other is in the 1800s. Older weapons are used. For example, I like Hunt's theme more. That's why CS is behind the others.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: For example, I am the person who uses bombs better in CS in my team. In Battlefield, I'm more of a observer, a long ranged weapon user. And the same in Hunt.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: It depends. Sometimes I am competitor when I win or am defeated, I feel those emotions high. But sometimes, I play calmly. It doesn’t matter if I win.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: It’s the basic of multiplayer games. You either win or not. Winning is important. As I said, sometimes it doesn’t matter to me. But important to my friends.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: We were playing with my friend as duo. Two of us really played hardcore. We gave importance. Also, we worked hard in CS. Sometimes we did. Once we had time such as vacations.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: If there is a ranking system, we do in general. It’s inevitable.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: In my team, there are some whose aiming skills is better than me. But mine is not too bad. Sometimes, I don’t understand why but sometimes if I gave too much break, I loose my muscle memory, my skill is not very good. It makes me sad but generally I am not too bad.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I’ve tried PUBG. Especially when it was first launched.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Two. My thumbs only. But as I said, I played when it was first launched but then I deleted. It really heated up my phone.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I don’t do research actively but sometimes I see them.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Steam, Youtube… Sometimes I see the news or promotions… Sometimes I see the news on Steam.  Other than that, sometimes from the people that I watch on Twitch. I am not active on Twitch recently due to my exams. The channels I watch on Youtube recommend some games. If I feel interested, I try them.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: If we play as a team, the most crucial thing is team spirit. And the second is the aiming skills of the players. And after that, the knowledge of the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Of course. If we find a good game that we can play with friends. But if I don’t play with my friends, I wouldn’t be so interested.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I heard a lot about Escape from Tarkov but I guess it’s on early access and the price is really high. I couldn’t reach it. But it’s really good. I would like to try it someday. I enjoy watching its videos. Hunt. I’ve been playing it for at least two years. I still enjoy playing it when I have time. I haven’t heard Cycle. I guess I have heard about Marauders but I don’t have any information about it. And the same with Vigor and Zero Sievert. I’ve heard about them but I don’t have any information about them. I haven’t heard about Hell is others. I’ve heard about Dark and Darker but I don’t have any information about it. About Warzone, is it the new version or?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I assume I’ve heard it. I assume it’s the new version. My friends were playing it but I couldn’t join them as I had the exams. But I want to try it out. I tried Battlefield 2042. It had some issues in the beginning. I am not sure about its recent status. I have a little knowledge and I didn’t try it much. And I played PUBG.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: If it’s the last mode, I don’t know. I played when it was first launched. I played for a year and then I stopped. I haven’t heard Arena and Lost Light. I played Badlanders a bit. It seems like Escape from Tarkov. It is not bad. I don’t know it has a mobile version but I saw it on Steam. I didn’t play mobile version but I might play.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I heard its name long time ago when it was first anounced. I liked the concept of the game. Especially recently in my free time, I watched its videos on Youtube and Twitch. I know how the game play is. I know a little about it but I heard that it had weird mechanics rather than killing. It’s about looting, raids, selling it out or collecting items and using them. I guess you have your own garage and do something over there. It’s different from other games. Therefore, I was curious about it. Especially graphics are realistic. Sounds are also very important just like Hunt. That’s why I like Hunt as well. Everything has a sound. That’s why I was impressed and I am still following it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: First person shooter game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: It’s different than other games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: It doesn’t come to my mind but it’s different than the others. Not like Hunt. Hunt is also different than the others. It’s not about defending a field or winning rounds. It is about looting. Therefore, it’s different than others.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I didn’t know that there was a this type of naming but yes. When you say that, it looks appropriate. But I couldn’t think of it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I knew that they were similar but I didn’t know there was a category called extraction looter. I think that’s exactly the name for the games. Hunt and Tarkov have that speciality. Badlanders has it as well. When you die, you loose your weapons and your character dies. It has a punitive style.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Both. I liked it in Hunt and I am sure that I would like it in Tarkov. I like a little torture. You have to work for it which is nice.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I am not that interested in other classical games like winning rounds. We are used to such games. Recently that type of game which is Valorant has been launched. I tried it a bit but it’s the same. Winning rounds and the same maps. Tarkov and Hunt have also similar maps but in the gameplay, they have different dynamics like escaping from different places. When you die, you choose your own gun, you have more gun options…These attract me more. If you die, loosing all you have is more attractive.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Based on my knowledge as I know some of them, these are more realistic in terms of graphics. They also look better compared to the others. And more importantly, there is a punitive and winning stystem which is appealing to me. Weapon variety and different varieties are advantages. These are the second and third ones. But firstly the looting mechanism.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Yes but you also have a change of winning.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Yes, the most appealing thing for me. And number two is more realistic graphics. And the third one is that especially in this type of games stress is a important factor compared to CS and the other classic games. Every sound is really important, even a cruck. It impresses me. You have to pay attention all the time.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: As I mentioned, the variety of weapons such as bombs. Also, characters in Hunt. There are different characters that you can play with. There are some free characters the game provides and there are also DLC skins that you can purchase which are also appealing for me. And the weapon skins…If I like the game, I pay for them and I can’t hold myself back.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I haven’t experienced them but I’ve been following them for a long time. I’ve talked about them with my friends but I couldn’t convince them. I’m still working on it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I think they are also fun games. As far as I remember you can also voice chat in game. Tarkov also has it. Hunt has it. Even Arma and Squad are good, Hunt and Tarkov are still better. Because they are more crowded but in Tarkov and Hunt you know what you are going to encounter with. How can I say…Less chaos. There is not a bullet rain. In other games, anything can happen.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Yes. It’s a good system. When you are looking around, you spend time there. You put them in your backpack. There is a limitation. It’s very detailed and nice. I think it is a bonus for Tarkov compared to others.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: In general, yes. Only I couldn’t convince them about Arma and Squad.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: They have the same opinion with me. They are also following the game and one day they want to try it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Yes, it’s a bit high. But one day I am sure that we will play together.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I haven’t played Tarkov but I think Tarkov would be on top even though I haven’t played it. I watched the gameplay. Other than that, the second one would be Hunt. And then I like Warzone. And then Battlefield comes.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Before me, two of my friends purchased the game and they described the game to me. I wasn’t fully engaged with FPS games and I declined their offer. But then on Discord when we were chatting, they started live stream. I watched them and thought that it was a good game. I wanted to try.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: As I mentioned, I liked the winning and losing risk mechanism. Other than that, it looks good. Weapons, sounds… I thought I could play.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: No. I purchased the game and started playing with my friends.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I think in total 600 hours.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Recently less because of my exams. During the pandemic, once we started playing the game, everyday. Minimum 3-4 hours a day.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Now less because of the exams. But before that during the school time, once or two times a week. Especially on weekends with my friends. Sometimes I played alone on weekends.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Around 2-3 hours. Less than the pandemic but still we didn’t give up on the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Sometimes my friends are not available or they want to play something else. But I play alone because I like Hunt. There are some people who play Hunt and I follow them on Twitch and Youtube. After I watch them, I feel motivated and I play alone.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I don’t have any issues with the game. I think everything is pretty good. I like Hunt very much. There is an optimization issue. Some of my friends have better PCs than mine. They have Monster. Even they have some problems. I had some FPS problems as well. It is not a much demanding game. We also adapt graphics not to have any problems but even for 60 FPS, it was hard to get. But still we play anyway.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Yes.  FPS drops and other stuff.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I haven’t played Tarkov but…

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: 1 point goes from that looting system because if I loose a lot, I would get sad until I get used to it. If I get used to it, it will be 10.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Its theme. As I mentioned, it is not classic as others, it is not about winning rounds and playing in more narrow areas. It has larger areas. There are innovative features in terms of gameplay. Realistic graphics and sounds. Especially for me, sounds impressed me a lot compared to other games. Those tiny crack sounds release your locations and give you a hint. It impresses me because you have to be careful.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Classic games are little below when compared to Hunt. I still play them but Hunt or Tarkov’s level is certain for me. I would say they are icing on the cake. You still play without them but they add another layer of taste.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Your characters and skills as you win or escape from the map gain level. Working hard for reaching for the maximum level is enjoyable for me. To keep my character alive, maximise its level and keeping them aside…

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Yes. Keeping it aside as a veteran.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Are we talking about the Hunt?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Shooting people is very fun because we shoot people in all games but in Hunt, there is an unique sound when you shoot headshot. Hearing that sound is so fun.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: The boss fights especially. There are some boss fights in Hunt. Other players around boss and that chaos environment are very fun. You try to kill the boss, you resorrect your teammate, you hide, you keep changing strategy because there is always an action. Those actions around the boss are very enjoyable.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Boss fights. Killing the boss, entering the boss area… These are all fun and important.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I have mentioned that it is different than other games. When I first played the game, I was an ameteur about the sounds. After getting used to it, it is so fun.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Playing with real people. I play RPG games as a simple player or against a computer. But in Hunt, you play against a real person which is more enjoyable.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Espeacially the sound of guns is satisfying. Once you get used to it. You can hear gun sounds from the farthest place in the map. It is really good. Either solo or with my team, when you hear a gun sound, we can tell each other which type of gun is used and which direction is coming from. It is really fun. Compared to other games, the sound of guns and guns itself are really good. The fact that they are adapted to the theme, single shoot guns which are specific to that era are really nice.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Snipers for instance, the long distance guns have more release. It is not like you hit wherever you look. It could go somewhere else. There is an error margin. It’s not like you shoot a guy and kill. It’s more realistic. Sometimes it doesn’t go wherever you want it to be. Hunt does that better.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: The reason why I still play the game is I still get the same pleasure. I am used to the game and I know the mechanism, the risk of loosing and winning.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: No. I just play it for fun. But sometimes with friends, we go hardcore. It’s been a while but there was a ranking system with stars. You enter the game based on your talent. Sometimes we go for that goal. But lately because of the school, I didn’t have time. I was a relax player. Either we kill or get killed. I am calmer now.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: The company who developed Hunt takes care of the game. The updates, new maps…There are updates still coming in. There are lots of developments. This motivates me and my friends a lot. Especially having new maps. Hunt has three maps but time period and whether change. It’s not like three maps. They have different functions. The map is huge and you can find anything. There is no limit. That motivates us as well.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Sometimes there are campers on the game which is bad. As I mentioned, sometimes there are FPS drops in terms of performance. Sometimes we quit the game because of this or even it could lead us to delete the game. We become so angry.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: FPS drop really bothers me but the latest updates fixed it a little bit. It’s better in terms of optimizations. Now I can’t think of any reason to abondon the game. I will keep playing it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: You can have a good time with your friends on a good map. Its theme and weapons are good. Other than that, its price was also affordable if it hasn’t updated recently. This is also an advantage. It provides a variety. I prefer the games that provides more variery rather than old school sytle, winning or loosing rounds. I think it is an advantage.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Game variety is really important compared to other classic games. That’s all.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: People continue watch and play CS and Valorant. These games still have a future. Hunt and Tarkov games or this type of games are very nice games. They could be competitors against others. They have a future ahead of them.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Firstly, the variety adds to the game. For instance, maps, guns, the areas to fight in the maps. When I consider CS or Valorant, I watch and play them occasionaly, they are too narrow compared to Hunt and Tarkov. I feel you cannot move or do whatever you want. That’s the first one. Secondly, Valorant and CS are more arcade or artificial.  Others are more realistic in terms of aiming and shooting people. It’s going to be appealing for the people.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Yes. The sensation of shooting and realistic guns.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I love. I love this gameplay. That’s why it’s my favorite. Tarkov and Hunt are my favorites and this is the reason why. I’m sure people will like it as well in time. It’s rather a new mechanism and it requires time but people will try it out and like it. Because the sensation you get out of winning or loosing is way higher because the risks are higher.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Yes, that’s what motivates me. That’s what keeps me going. The development and improvement of the character. In Tarkov and Hunt, you can able to use better guns or matching your guns to your talent level. Developing your character is more advantageous. These are all important factors that will be motivating to other players as well.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: At first my goal was to learn the game because it was different than other classic games. Killing people and learning about guns. But the more I got used to the game, the more I learned about it. After the feature of ranking based on your talent was updated in the game, I worked hard for ranking and killing more, I was more ambitious about money, buying nice things with money, having more better guns.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: At first no. It was not important if I got killed. I was just trying to learn the game. But then improving my character has become a goal for me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Of course. The map is much bigger. You can do anything on the map. You can have different conflicts on different areas on the map. I guess Tarkov has that too. In each game you need to decide where you will combat. The fact that it is very different is important for me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Map is very important. In terms of freedom, having more gun options or you need to change your play style depending on the gun. You have to adapt another style each time you pick another gun. Compared to other games, especially in Hunt, you can play differently based on the gun you pick. This gives a freedom.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Of course they are important. It adds innovation to the game. It makes it harder. It is hard to control and aim. It makes the game a lot harder. If you aim well, you become a killer. So, it adds another perspective to the shooter games. It’s much more realistic. And I am sure people will be drawn to that.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I can’t give examples from Tarkov but in Hunt, one game could go up to one hour. If it hadn’t been so immersive, you couldn’t play it. Because sometimes you have to wait and you have to be very attentive. You have to really focused. I guess it’s called super immersion. It’s very important if it is going to be a long game. If it is going to be a shorter one, it’s okay but being super immersion is very important for longer games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Especially the map variety and gun variety in terms of freedom is the number one. As I said, when I play other classic games, maps are too small for me. My friends don’t feel this way but I feel it especially after playing Hunt. I am restricted in terms of movement. You are easy to get shot from any angle. There are certain points in those maps that you can get shot. Also, people memorise those maps and it’s become too hard to play. If you make a mistake, you will be punished. So, having map variety and map sizes was the most impressive thing for me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: What do you mean by fantasy? Can you give me an example?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I can’t think of any game like that.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Yes, it could be nice. I could give it a chance. If it provides a good gameplay and variety, it would be different from others. It would worth trying.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Yes, it would definitely try. Because I’m interested in fantastic features. I would definitely give it a chance.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Not in that one. I don’t think it would suit to the theme. It’s already beautiful as it is. I don’t think it’s necessary.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Yes. Also, in Hunt. There is no need.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: First, map should be big. There should be different areas to combat. Weapon variety should be enough because if you don’t have enough, it would be boring. I think in these games, sound is very important. They should pay attention to sounds like in Tarkov and Hunt. It would be nice if they have a theme but if they have fantastic features, that’s okay too. I’m not saying that it should be 100% real life. It doesn’t have to be realistic. As long as it has a big map and variety in terms of map, nice sounds, weapon options, it’s okay. But if it’s realistic, it’s the cream of the cake as you said, it would be much better.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I can repeat the ones I listed before then. Beautiful map, sound is important, weapon variety.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Bomb issue is a little weak in Hunt. There are some varieties of bombs but I don’t like throwing bombs around or I don’t like the variery of bombs. There might be some bombs that you can use effectively. Maybe flying or climbing options can be added in map. Would I add it to the ideal game or if it is okay if I don’t put? It’s not a must.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Yes. Nice to have. I’ve talked about the map. And if they interact with the map, it would be better. This is what missing in Hunt.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I have some prejudices towards buying skins. I don’t think skin is very necessary. Why would you waste your money with that…

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Yes, of course. I said I have some prejudices but I have purchased skins too. If you like it, you can’t stop and you buy it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Skin purchasing and selling is available in CS which is nice. I don’t have any information about microtransactions.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: Did you ask this question for earning real money or in game money?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I think such real money trade would make people interested. Some people would gain small or big profits. I guess people would love it.  People would be appealed to the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: In shooter games like this, you may want to have skins or cosmetics. It’s okay. But in some games, there is a pay-to-win issue which is a problem. I am against pay-to-win. But I’m fine with skins and cosmetics.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: It’s turning into gambling but I love it. If I have some money, I can’t resist it and I buy it. I like it. Even though I get something small, it’s okay. The excitement and the possibility of getting something big are positive. I think people would love it as well.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I can’t think of anything but the last thing you said, the loot boxes. If they integrate that system into Hunt, it would be nice.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: It should be rare so it has some value. Let’s say if it gives you a box at the end of the game, a surprise box would be nice. But purchasing from the market, I’m fine with that too.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D7-英文原版
text: I would think positively. I’m into loot boxes. I can’t resist it.
